title: Density; Pressure and hydrostatics
source: Questions copied unchanged from the mission-lesson scripts for OCR A-level (A) Physics (status of the source: mission-lesson scripts of Oct-Nov 2026 (reviewed by AI reviewers; not signed off by a person)). Terms and clues: FL02-1#t3 term and clue written for the game; FL02-1#t2 term and clue written for the game; FL01-1#t2 term and clue written for the game; FL01-1#t1 term and clue written for the game. Questions: FL01-1#N.4, FL02-1#N.2, FL02-1#N.3, FL02-1#N.10.

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Incompressible
items.clue: Describes a liquid whose ρ is the same at every depth.

items.label: Pascal
items.clue: Unit equal to 1 N m⁻², that is, one newton on each square m.

items.label: Top-pan balance
items.clue: Instrument, zeroed first, used to measure the mass of a sample.

items.label: Density
items.clue: Mass per unit volume; it belongs to the material, not to the object.

questions.stem: The density of aluminium is 2.7 g cm⁻³. What is the volume, in m³, of an aluminium block of mass 0.081 kg?
A force of 50 N acts on a flat plate of area 25 cm². The force is at 60° to the plate's surface. What pressure does the force exert on the plate?
questions.explanation: The angle is from the surface, so the perpendicular component is 50 sin 60° = 43.3 N. A = 25 × 10⁻⁴ m², so pressure = 43.3 ÷ 2.5 × 10⁻³ = 1.7 × 10⁴ Pa.

questions.stem: A sealed container holds a gas at a pressure of 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa. Which statement about this pressure is correct?

options.text: The gas presses mainly on the base of the container, because gas pressure acts downwards.
Pressure is a vector, so the pressures acting on opposite walls of the container cancel out.
The gas exerts a force of 1.0 × 10⁵ N on each wall, whatever the area of that wall.
The gas pushes perpendicular to every wall, exerting 1.0 × 10⁵ N on each square metre of wall.

questions.stem: A fluid at pressure P pushes on a circular piston of radius r and exerts a force of magnitude F on it, perpendicular to the piston. The same fluid pressure acts on a second circular piston of radius 2r. The magnitude of the force on the second piston is how many times F?
